ralplan_architect_review.summary: V1 is architecturally sound after scoping to capture-based paths, raw-first classifier precedence, bounded raw retention, and preserving command-module ownership. Streaming/passthrough are deferred or excluded from post-hoc compression.

ralplan_critic_review.summary: Plan is actionable for execution. Test spec covers classifier precedence, runner modes, TOML fallback, raw retention, command ownership, planted-error preservation, and rollout modes.
residual_risks: Exact classifier heuristics still need careful implementation.
TOML paths with stderr need care if enforcing raw-stderr precedence without changing UX.
Raw-output retention may expose sensitive output; bounded config and tee policy reduce but do not eliminate this risk.

recommended_next_steps.implementation_repo: Apply in an RTK checkout/fork, not this planning-only tfy workspace unless intentionally vendoring RTK.
recommended_next_steps.team: $team .omx/plans/prd-rtk-command-output-compression.md for parallel lanes: core output_budget, runner integration, TOML fallback, tests/evaluation.
recommended_next_steps.ralph_fallback: $ralph .omx/plans/prd-rtk-command-output-compression.md only if explicitly selecting single-owner persistence.
